abilities.description: Underwater breathing: You do not have to make preparations to go underwater, you breathe underwater freely, and filter out most toxins in the water if they are present, and whenever you are underwater fighting against a foe that does not breathe underwater, you are ALWAYS in control. Always take +1 to any rolls while swimming.

Ink spray: Once per session, @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.ff32c523829d6481]{Endure Stress} (-2) to use your spitting ink in a way that gains you leverage, and take a +1 to your next roll where you reap the benefits of that leverage.
